scope: Scoped human/source-maintainer questions only; does not certify the whole corpus ready for final acceptance.

questions.question: Supply a source-issued well-formed record or authoritative edition with exact IG150 identity and language evidence. Do not silently repair the preserved malformed XML.
evidence_prerequisites: Corrected source-issued XML or a separately inspected authoritative edition with explicit entry identity and language evidence.
questions.effect_of_no_decision: Retain existing quarantine, alternatives and non-admission.

acceptance_route: Use native independent-review and human-maintainer verification requirements. Filling or validating this prepared request grants no admission.
